description: Interactive gene view for one Brassica gene: a relationship map of its orthologues in B. rapa, B. oleracea, B. juncea, Camelina and Arabidopsis, Arabidopsis function, presence/absence across the B. napus (53 accessions) or B. oleracea (10) pangenome by crop form, BnIR stress responses (ZS11 copies), Expression Atlas contrasts and recent papers, with tabs for pangenome presence by form, a BnIR stress time-course heatmap and baseline expression. Clients that support MCP Apps show it in the chat; the result also lists the nodes, the panel data and the gene page link (page) to share. gene: gene name or Ensembl/LIS ID.
name: brassica_gene_view
